P.note: Vivid saturated blue sky over electric green hills with a clearly legible card, though the glossy card reads more as a bright glossy panel than deep acrylic.

Q.note: The up-next queue runs off the bottom of the 1280x800 page, the artwork is a muddy teal, and the prev/next buttons are blank.

R.note: Clean and readable with pale overexposed whites, but the card reads as an opaque pale plate rather than translucent acrylic and the grass is flat bands.

S.note: Strongest Frutiger Aero atmosphere with blade-detailed grass and bubbles, but the header text is low contrast and the prev/next buttons look unfinished.

T.note: Generic blurred clouds and an opaque pale-blue card with blank prev/next buttons make the material feel painted rather than luminous.

U.note: Convincing translucent blue slab with a sky bloom, glowing green-edged hills and a fully visible queue, slightly softer on the grass electricity.
